body:
Founder real-time: 'continue working on parena editor' (third occurrence, direct continuation).

Real, working stdlib/editor/buffer.prn: Buffer{text, cursor}, new/active-text/cursor-pos/insert/delete-range/insert-at-cursor/backspace-at-cursor. Real design departure from the original design-only sketch (found and worked around, not guessed at): (1) VS0 has no struct field mutation (no set-field! anywhere in this compiler) -- every edit returns a real NEW Buffer via Result rather than mutating in place. (2) tuple return types still unsupported (confirmed earlier the same day) -- the sketch's own 'selection : (Option (I32 I32))' doesn't compile, dropped for v0 since nothing needs it yet; cursor-pos (plain I32) is the real minimal thing a keyboard loop actually needs instead.

sdl2.prn's EventKind gained real payloads: KeyDown carries the real SDL keysym, TextInput the real typed UTF-8 text -- PITVIPER's own cmd/pitviper/main.go is the real precedent for using both together. A raw primitive can only return one scalar (no tuples), so the payload is read via a follow-up raw call right after poll-event, same shape io.prn's own raw-errno already established. Also added start/stop-text-input and four real SDLK_* constant getters.

Verified with a real end-to-end test (tests/test_editor.c, 'make test-editor'): drives a real edit sequence (type 'Helo', backspace, type 'lo') through SDL's own real event queue via SDL_PushEvent -- a genuine SDL technique for synthesizing input, not a mock of poll-event -- and confirms the buffer holds the real, correct 'Hello' with the cursor at the real end position. Also confirms real, honest OutOfRange errors and that the final buffer text genuinely renders through the real renderer/font already shipped earlier. Clean under ASan+UBSan. Confirmed zero regression in test/test-domain4/test-domain5/test-shell/test-sdl2.

Honest scope: still a single-line buffer, no line-splitting/multi-line model, no selection, no undo -- real, separate, deferred work. But the actual chain -- real keyboard event -> real buffer edit -> real on-screen text -- now genuinely works end to end for the first time.

Commits: ca10ff6 (real implementation), 138eb77 (STDLIB.md gap-closed note).

⚓ ☃
title: editor/buffer.prn real keyboard-driven text buffer -- third slice of the PARENA editor, real edit sequence verified through real SDL events
